questions.scenario_zh: 周五傍晚刚下班，最想做的是？
questions.scenario_en: It's Friday at 6pm, you just finished work — what do you most want to do?
options_zh: 回工作室把那个一直卡住的点子做完
五公里跑或体能训练，把纪律感拉回来
叫上最信的几个人，去能大声说话的地方喝一杯
options_en: Back to the studio and finish the stuck idea
Five-k or training — pull discipline back
The few you trust, somewhere you can talk loud

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友凌晨两点哭着打电话来，说刚被分手。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your closest friend calls you at 2am, crying — they just got dumped. What's your first move?
options_zh: 先远程把对方今晚需要的资源都安排好，再出现
问清事实链，给出三步可执行方案
人到了再说，先确保对方不是一个人
options_en: Arrange resources tonight remotely, then show up
Clarify facts, hand a three-step plan
Just get there — they're not alone

questions.scenario_zh: 会议上你的方案被领导当众说"逻辑不通"，你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: In a meeting, your boss publicly says your proposal 'doesn't make logical sense.' Your reaction?
options_zh: 当场用数据和类比把逻辑补完，语气可以硬
记下反驳点，会后再用更冷静的方式提交
表面不动，内心把这个人从可合作名单划掉
options_en: Rebuild logic with data on the spot — tone can be hard
Log counterpoints, submit calmer version later
Still on surface, strike them from collaborate list

questions.scenario_zh: 你突然收到一笔 5 万块的意外奖金，第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: An unexpected bonus drops into your account. What's your gut move?
options_zh: 一半投进能放大影响力的项目，一半给团队
先还债和应急金，再按清单买
请所有人吃一顿，剩下的慢慢规划
options_en: Half into scaling impact, half to the team
Debt and emergency fund first, then list
Feed everyone first, plan the rest

questions.scenario_zh: 第一次约会，你倾向于怎么安排？
questions.scenario_en: First date — how do you want to set it up?
options_zh: 能深聊的安静场所，看对方是否诚实
轻松场合，用观察判断值不值得第二次
做点冒险的事，看对方敢不敢一起
options_en: Quiet enough for depth — watch if they're honest
Casual — observe whether a second date earns itself
Something slightly risky — see if they'll go

questions.scenario_zh: 室友把你冰箱里准备明天招待客人的食材提前吃掉了。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your roommate ate the food you were saving in the fridge for tomorrow's guests. Your reaction?
options_zh: 嘴上说没事，心里升级冰箱协议
讽刺后要求等价赔偿
一起定规则，避免下次
options_en: Say fine, upgrade fridge protocol in your head
Sarcasm, then demand equivalent replacement
Co-write rules so there's no next time

questions.scenario_zh: 派对上你被介绍给一个看起来很有趣的陌生人，你的开场是？
questions.scenario_en: At a party, you get introduced to someone who looks interesting. Your opener?
options_zh: 用自嘲开场，再认真问对方在做什么
把对方介绍给最能帮到TA的人
直接问你最怕的是什么并等答案
options_en: Self-deprecation, then what they're working on
Introduce them to whoever could actually help
Ask what they're most afraid of and wait

questions.scenario_zh: 最好的朋友突然出大事，半夜来找你帮忙。你的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Your best friend hits a sudden crisis and shows up at your door at midnight. First move?
options_zh: 接手最难的部分，让对方先睡
列资源、联系人、时间线
陪着，不多话，直到对方稳定
options_en: Take hardest piece so they sleep
Resources, contacts, timeline
Stay, few words, until stable

questions.scenario_zh: 你最讨厌的人意外升职了。你心里的第一反应是？
questions.scenario_en: Someone you can't stand just got promoted. Your first internal reaction?
options_zh: 准备质疑流程是否公平
专注自己的任务，不分配恨意
想一秒就放下，情绪太贵
options_en: Question whether the process was fair
Focus on your mission, don't budget hatred
One second, drop it — emotions too expensive

questions.scenario_zh: 想象十年后的自己，你最希望的画面是？
questions.scenario_en: Picture yourself ten years from now — what's the version you most hope for?
options_zh: 影响力用来保护更多人，而不是表演
有一段不需要盔甲的关系
身体与意志仍服务于信念
options_en: Influence to protect people, not perform
A relationship without armor
Body and will still serve conviction

questions.scenario_zh: 凌晨三点你毫无征兆地醒了，再也睡不着。你最可能做什么？
questions.scenario_en: It's 3am and you're suddenly wide awake. Most likely move?
options_zh: 处理一个一直拖延的硬问题
拉伸、呼吸，把失控感压下去
刷轻松内容直到困
options_en: Tackle one hard problem you've avoided
Stretch, breathe, push loss-of-control down
Light content until sleep

questions.scenario_zh: 朋友做了件不光彩的小事，求你在被问到时帮对方圆一下。你的反应是？
questions.scenario_en: A friend did something slightly off and asks you to cover for them if asked. Your reaction?
options_zh: 不撒谎，帮想最小伤害的表述
可以挡一句，但下次对方要还人情
拒绝，陪对方去面对
options_en: No lying — least-harm wording
One shield sentence, they owe you next time
Refuse — accompany through facing it
